README.md.title: README
README.md.summary: Documentation hub for the Obsidian vault explaining how the AI-powered organization agent works, including folder structure, agent capabilities (tagging, linking, theming, summarizing), configuration, and troubleshooting.

notes/All Kings.md.title: All Kings
notes/All Kings.md.summary: Presents a roster of powerful figures in technology, finance, and politics who shape global systems, mapping concentration of power across domains with emphasis on Peter Thiel's network as a connecting thread through multiple power centers.

notes/Research - Note-Taking Studies.md.title: Research - Note-Taking Studies
notes/Research - Note-Taking Studies.md.summary: Collects research findings on effective note-taking including the generation effect, spacing effect, and elaborative interrogation, building an evidence base for active note-taking practices and questioning how AI augmentation might enhance or hinder these effects.

notes/Palantir Origin Story.md.title: Palantir Origin Story
notes/Palantir Origin Story.md.summary: Documents the founding meeting between Peter Thiel, Alex Karp, and Admiral John Poindexter that led to Palantir's creation as a privatized continuation of DARPA's defunded Total Information Awareness (TIA) program, revealing the direct government-to-startup pipeline for surveillance technology.

notes/Palantir Products.md.title: Palantir Products
notes/Palantir Products.md.summary: Provides a comprehensive overview of Palantir's core product suite: Gotham (intelligence/defense), Foundry (enterprise), and Apollo (deployment infrastructure), documenting how they function as an integrated surveillance and data analytics ecosystem.

notes/AI Writing Assistant Idea.md.title: AI Writing Assistant Idea
notes/AI Writing Assistant Idea.md.summary: Explores the concept of a writing assistant that goes beyond grammar correction to understand the author's intent and vault context, envisioning context-aware suggestions, pattern learning, idea connections, and outline generation.

notes/Corporate Cabal.md.title: Corporate Cabal
notes/Corporate Cabal.md.summary: Documents research into the historical collaboration between U.S. intelligence agencies and liberal/progressive NGOs, foundations, and media organizations, exploring how the 'Liberal CIA' concept connects to modern tech ecosystem dynamics and government-private sector relationships.

notes/Personal Knowledge Management.md.title: Personal Knowledge Management
notes/Personal Knowledge Management.md.summary: Outlines the author's PKM system and philosophy, defining principles (capture quickly, process regularly, connect actively, review periodically), documenting tools (Obsidian, Git, automated agents), and acknowledging maintenance as the central challenge motivating AI-assisted organization.

notes/2024-02-10 Morning Reflection.md.title: 2024-02-10 Morning Reflection
notes/2024-02-10 Morning Reflection.md.summary: Personal morning reflection capturing the author's motivation to organize notes and excitement about AI-assisted note organization, articulating the value of surfacing connections, revealing patterns, and setting a daily intention to focus on building systems rather than just capturing information.

notes/Flock Camera Investors.md.title: Flock Camera Investors
notes/Flock Camera Investors.md.summary: Catalogs the investor list for Flock Safety, a surveillance technology company, demonstrating how mainstream Silicon Valley VCs have legitimized surveillance-as-a-service with emphasis on the Founders Fund connection linking Flock to the broader Palantir/Peter Thiel ecosystem.

notes/LinkedIn.md.title: LinkedIn
notes/LinkedIn.md.summary: Analyzes LinkedIn as more than a professional networking platform, framing it as a national security asset and media controller that represents the convergence of social networking, professional identity, and media influence.
